facts.claim: Each fixed member has its own adapter, SDK conversation directory, role instruction, context transport and history.
All member actual usage is summed in TeamLedger.actual and uses one shared 5,000,000-token pool.
Each member uses full_history through a summarizing managed transport; this does not mean the entire unbounded raw history is sent unchanged.
v132 inherits the v131 model runtime; its change here is the preparation hash implementation.
Known actual usage is prompt_tokens plus completion_tokens; cache-hit and cache-miss input are subsets of prompt_tokens, not deductions from task tokens.

limits: Private context separation establishes a mechanism for repeated information acquisition, not an estimate of avoidable semantic duplication.
No counterfactual model prompts with communications removed were tokenized.
Communication-related history may appear in subsequent noncommunication requests; the action-attribution table is not net communication cost.
A normal noncash stop below5M does not prove another organizational action was reachable or another cash reservation was available.
